argv: echo 'Enter a coding task'; n=0; d="$HOME/.config/manicode/projects/$(basename "$PWD")/chats/e2e-chat"; mkdir -p "$d"; body=''; while IFS= read -r line; do line=$(printf '%s' "$line" | tr -d '\033' | sed 's/\[20[01]~//g'); n=$((n+1)); [ -z "$body" ] || body="$body,"; body="$body$(printf '{"variant":"user","id":"u%s","content":"%s"},{"variant":"ai","id":"a%s","blocks":[{"type":"text","content":"ECHO: %s"}],"isComplete":true}' "$n" "$line" "$n" "$line")"; printf '[%s]' "$body" > "$d.tmp"; mv "$d.tmp" "$d/chat-messages.json"; done
